items.title: Sadie Goodson Interview, 1984-12-12
items.q: His name was Napoleon. Napoleon Jenkins. My mother's brother's name.

ctx.x: Do you know what he did, what kind of business he did or what he did for me? My grandfather? You know what? He made gardens, he loved gardens. Planked all kinds of vegetables.

He had one of the beautiful vegetable yards you've ever seen. And he got him a parrot, so he could talk. He had vines over his little house where he was living at. The parrot behind the vine. And when somebody come over there to go in that garden, the parrot would holler, get out of that garden, get out of that garden, get out of that garden. But they didn't know, they thought it was a real place, you see. Sometimes Grandpa would be going out somewhere. Then some of the men when they go to bring wood in, stuff…
interest. I wanted to ask you, Sadie, you mentioned that Buddy Petit's band came through Pensacola. There were several others from New Orleans that came through there?
